notes.title: Update January 15, 2025
notes.notes:
1. Fixed non-working ability to manually place medications in the basket while it's on the counter.
2. Default music has been added to the audio player. Delete it and copy your .mp3 files to \Users\user\Documents\RealPharmacySimulator\mp3 folder to remove it completely. While your files are in this folder, copying will not occur.
3. The audio player can now be picked up.
4. Fixed a ceiling lamp that wasn't responding to the switch.
5. Added to the list of goods for sale:
- Thermometer
- DermaclearActive
6. Added two new symptoms

notes.title: Patch of January 13, 2025
notes.notes:
Fixed UI text that was not displayed when hovering over plant seeds.
Fixed UI text that covered part of the camera when using the terminal and picking up medical prescriptions.
Fixed a bug where upon leveling up, the text displaying the current day name was replaced with the level value (:D)
The water bottle now fills up correctly again.
